name: Lumen Charm
description: A palm-sized charm that emits steady witchlight when invoked.
narrative_effects: Provides reliable light and supports exploration in darkness without open flame.

mechanical_effect.trigger: invoked and one charge is active, producing steady witchlight
mechanical_effect.applies_to: exploration, searching, travel, or manipulation checks where reliable light in darkness without open flame materially helps
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: bright-light signaling, heat/fire needs, concealment in darkness, or checks unaffected by visibility
